sources.entry: AuroraEditor - Lightweight Code Editor (IDE) for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Aurora Editor is a Swift-built, native macOS integrated development environment (IDE) with multi-language support and Git integration, though the project has announced it is being sunset.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Aurora Editor as an IDE written in Swift for macOS, positioned as a native alternative to Electron-based editors and as offering an Xcode-like experience with multi-language support and Git integration. It lists built-in development tools, though the README does not enumerate them. The README points to a Discord, Slack, and Matrix (beta) community, a nightly build as the only download currently offered, and guides on contributing, architecture, development, and troubleshooting. It also has a localization effort for translating the app. The top of the README announces that the maintainers have decided to sunset the project, with the code remaining on GitHub for forking.
use_cases: Writing code in a native macOS editor
Exploring or forking an Xcode-like IDE in Swift
Using an editor with built-in Git integration
Coding in multiple programming languages on a Mac
Contributing to an open-source macOS IDE
Translating an editor into another language
how_to_run: Download the nightly build linked from the README's Download section
notable: Native macOS app written in Swift, positioned against Electron-based editors
Xcode-like feel with added multi-language support
Built-in Git integration, per the README
Community chat on Discord, Slack, and Matrix (beta)
caveats: The maintainers have announced the project is being sunset; the code remains on GitHub but development is ending
Only a nightly build is available; no release build yet
Limited to macOS, as a native macOS application
